description: A control the application positions itself must keep its geometry. Carillon centres its main heading in code at start-up, and the planner - reading only the designer geometry - moved and resized it, overwriting a decision already made and one that is never made again. The caption is still translated; only the layout is left alone. lblOrdinary is in the same form and is not mentioned in the unit, so it must still be laid out normally: without it, a contract that passed by disabling the planner altogether would look identical to one that passed for the right reason.
